tests.name: MAIN actions, page DOM events, and popup adapter expose the same registry
First autoLayout click waits for native startup without Capture or reload
STOP cancels startup waiting before any request
Route changes during startup cannot retarget the action
Auto-layout dry-run reads once, never saves and returns an inverse
Auto-layout saves only geometry, is idempotent and inverse restores positions
Wrong-target inverse is rejected before dispatch
STOP interrupts layout before SaveCanvas
Upload dry-run makes zero calls
Upload executes ticket, signed PUT, import in order and accounts
Public RPC cannot replace authenticated replay headers
CreateCanvas defaults to dry-run with zero requests
Creation replays observed empty CreateProject body, then separate rename
Wrong canvas rejected before any dispatch
CreateNode dry-run leaves native body unchanged and sends nothing
CreateNode appends using captured node and save envelope; one save and one revision read
ConnectNodes uses observed source/target/port shape
Generate dry-run contains recipe and captured run constants with zero requests
Generate saves parameters, submits once, and records balance
Submitted task remains tracked; a second generation is rejected
WaitTask polls terminal state and returns redacted output plus final accounting
Fixed model, texture, rig and UV types use captured CreateRun without changing their recipes
Final save retains outputs returned by the latest read
STOP aborts pending transport immediately
Evidence does not persist auth or signed URL query values
Popup has all buttons and parses arguments for named actions
Fresh canvas needs no prior native SaveCanvas or CreateRun template
Lab template creates a fresh native Lab without a supplied template
Existing canvas asset binding uses real public action and native inputMount
Non-image Lab output/input ports survive native save and revision read
Lab job/artifact discovery uses ownership-scoped read contracts
Unpublished GLB artifact uploads/imports once and appends native reference
Original artifact download traverses writer bridge and returns verified receipt

scope: Actual source, MAIN/isolated/page-event bridge, mocked transport; no Tripo requests
limitations: Offline transport tests only; the new actions still require live verification after extension reload.
